title: General close junta existence
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function. For real numbers $\epsilon,\eta>0$ and an integer $k\ge0$, suppose the total influence $I(f)$ is positive and the sum of squared Fourier coefficients over sets of size greater than $k$ is at most $\epsilon$. Put $C=(2/\eta+1)^{1+\eta}$ and $M=I(f)^{2+\eta}/(\epsilon^{1+\eta}C^k)$. There exist a coordinate set $J$ and a Boolean function $g$ such that $|J|\le M$, the sum of squared Fourier coefficients of $f$ outside the family of sets $S\subseteq J$ with $|S|\le k$ is at most $2\epsilon$, $g$ depends on at most $|J|$ coordinates, and the fraction of inputs on which $f$ and $g$ differ is at most $\epsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube to the signs
The total influence of $f$ is positive
The Fourier weight on sets of size greater than $k$ is at most $\epsilon$
